hero.title: Assistive technology built by Yale students
hero.text: Engineers and medical students designing open-source devices with the people who know the need firsthand, then giving them away at no cost. **Eight projects are in build this year.**
hero.imageAlt: Y-AID students reviewing a 3D model of a prosthetic on a large screen

about.title: Built around the people who use it
about.text: We work with disabled people, patients, clinicians and caregivers to understand the barriers they meet, then design and refine practical devices around their feedback. From rehabilitation tools to everyday hospital equipment, the aim is the same: useful technology that more people can reach.
about.imageAlt: Y-AID students assembling a prototype at a workbench

stats.title: Building free devices since 2020
stats.text: Founded as Yale e-NABLE, the club became Y-AID and a Tikkun Olam Makers chapter in 2025.

items.label: Cost to the people we serve

mission.quote: Free, customizable assistive devices for those in need across Greater New Haven.
